EXPECTED — 02-notes-batch.txt
=============================
Eight dictated notes, Pebble-scale. This is the file that matters: it carries
every damage pattern from the real corpus and enough vocabulary for repair to
have something to match against.

THE SEVEN THINGS TO JUDGE, in the order they get decided:

1. INTENT — the last two notes are REQUESTS, not claims.
   "Generate a comparison document… and email it to me" and "Run a research
   task…" must be routed to TASKS by rdf/note-intent.ts, never recorded as
   facts. A fact asserting that a document was generated is a claim nobody
   made. THIS IS THE HIGHEST-VALUE ASSERTION IN THE CORPUS — getting it wrong
   silently writes invented history into the graph.

2. SUBJECT SHAPE — no entity slug may be a whole sentence.
   Watch for: lumenpath-is-an-enterprise-cad-platform,
   jordan-veil-owns-northwind-analytics-llc. The guard catches these; their
   appearance is a regression.

3. VOCABULARY REPAIR — "lumen path" (note 3) should now be repairable, because
   note 1 seeded "Lumenpath" into the graph. Expect a SUGGEST-band proposal,
   not an automatic merge: repair proposes, the human settles.
   "Recon's AI" -> Reckons.AI scored 0.85 on real transcripts — suggest band.

4. THE HOMOPHONE WILL SURVIVE. "enterprise damn" and "enterprise cad" will not
   be corrected. Nothing knows the acronym; "damn" and "cad" are real words, so
   no lexical or phonetic signal exists to fire on. RECORD IT, do not re-file
   it — this is the known unsolvable case (homophones, per the real-transcript
   analysis: "dams"/"DAMs" is unsolvable at this tier).

5. SPLIT PROPER NOUNS — "A primo and binder and open text" should ideally yield
   three vendors (Aprimo, Bynder, OpenText). It almost certainly will not.
   The decoder split them before the extractor ever saw them, so this is an
   ASR-boundary failure, not an extraction failure. Judge whether the extractor
   at least produces separable entities rather than one run-on blob.

6. CO-HYPONYMS — "node attribute name / value / type / count" plus "a node
   attribute for how many times to repeat the action" is the seam case, five
   siblings sharing a head.
   EXPECTED TODAY: vocabulary-repair offers to MERGE them (wrong, destructive)
   and nothing proposes a parent, because proposeCoHyponyms is not wired into
   the app. Confirm the merge proposals appear — that is the bug this corpus
   exists to demonstrate in the UI.

7. AGGREGATION — all eight notes share one ingest source, so the same-source
   cascade basis should form ONE bookkeeping question, not eight. It must not
   swallow the CLAIMS: only record/log altitude is cascadable, and the claims
   above are judgments.

WHAT A GOOD RUN LOOKS LIKE: two tasks, no invented facts, a handful of suggest-
band repairs, and a review queue where the claims are separable and the
bookkeeping is behind a count.
